title: Sierre-Zinal rules — registration and benefits (art. 23–30)
claims: Article 23 limits the Tourist category to 4,000 participants, the Runner category to 2,100, the Chandolin–Zinal junior race to 250 and the children's race to 500.
Article 23 allows the organiser to run a free pre-registration for residents of the municipalities of the Sierre district and to hold a draw if that quota is exceeded.
Article 24 sets the entry fee at CHF 110 for the Tourist and Runner categories, excluding options.
Article 26 provides a free shuttle from Sierre station to the start, a return bus from Zinal, transport of a belongings bag and a post-race meal.
Article 25 states that registration is personal and non-transferable and that entry fees are not refunded.
Article 23 states that in principle no on-site registration is possible on race day for any category or event.

verification.note: 2026-11-08 直取官网英文规则 Art. 23–30。费用与人数均为方括号数字，规则说明可逐年调整；本页按当前版本抄录，不把它当作 2027 届最终值。
